scripts.build: npm run check && npm run build:web && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist-worker

scripts.db:migrate:production: node scripts/deploy-guard.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply atelier-db --remote --config wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: node scripts/deploy-guard.mjs && npm run configure:cloudflare && npm run db:migrate:production && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc
